items.title: This tracker ranks AI data center leaders on emissions
items.summary: New data centers purpose-built for artificial intelligence are stoking a natural gas generation boom, forcing double-digit emissions increases at Amazon, Google and Microsoft .

items.title: Indigenous leaders present UN with roadmap to protect communities
items.summary: At the latest session of the Expert Mechanism on the rights of Indigenous Peoples (EMRIP), members proposed a 12-step plan to help protect Indigenous communities from mounting threats.

items.title: Ed Miliband to lead UK engagement at World Bank on climate and development
items.summary: The UK Government has announced that the Foreign Secretary, Ed Miliband, will take on the role of UK Governor to the World Bank, taking personal leadership of the UK’s engagement on international development and climate finance.

items.title: What do the Government’s new drought plans mean for businesses?
items.summary: Drought has been declared in parts of the UK for the first time this year as hosepipe bans spread and water shortages intensify.

items.title: Britain’s diet is overshooting planetary boundaries, says Lidl
items.summary: Britain reached its 2026 Planetary Health Diet Overshoot Day on 25 July, meaning the country has already exceeded its annual recommended balance of foods for a healthy and sustainable diet.

items.title: China to grow renewable generation by 50% by 2030
items.summary: China has set out a new energy transition plan that would see non-fossil fuel sources contribute to 50% of total power generation by 2030 alongside a peak in fossil fuel consumption.

items.title: Don’t go quiet: Why leaders need to double down on sustainability
items.summary: With some companies retreating from public sustainability commitments amid growing ESG scepticism, Martina Donohoe, sustainability and safety director at Bidvest Noonan, explains why 'greenhushing' is actually a reputational risk.
